name: Shipping times
description: Customer asks how long delivery takes or when their order will arrive.
examples: Do you ship to Canada, and how long does it take?

rules.condition: The customer is upset, angry or frustrated.
The customer says their order is lost, missing or never arrived.
The customer mentions legal action, a lawyer, a chargeback or disputing the payment with their bank.
The customer asks to talk to a person, a human or a member of staff.

steps.message: I'm passing this to our team so a person can help. Someone will follow up with you soon.

steps.question: Just to check, is this about how long shipping takes?
Has the customer confirmed that their question is about how long shipping or delivery takes?

paths.description: The customer confirms it is about shipping or delivery times.
The customer says it is not about shipping or delivery times.

steps.text: No problem. What can I help you with instead?

steps.message: I want to make sure you get the right answer, so I'm passing this to our team. Someone will follow up with you soon.

steps.question: Based on the conversation, which kind of shipping is the customer asking about?

paths.description: Standard delivery to an address within the country.
Faster, express or next-day delivery to an address within the country.
Delivery to an address in another country.

steps.text: Standard shipping within [the US] takes [3–5] business days once your order ships. We'll email you a tracking link as soon as it's on its way.
Express shipping within [the US] arrives in [1–2] business days. You can choose it at checkout.
International orders usually arrive in [7–14] business days, depending on the destination and customs.

steps.question: Happy to help. Where are we shipping to?
buttons: Within the US, as fast as possible
